notes: Third mistake: "Nuôi lẻ hoặc ít con thì cá nhát" claims that keeping few fish makes them timid. The page only says they like living in a group (best six or more). It links timidity to having no fish in the upper water ("có những loài này bơi phía trên, cá cũng bớt nhát hơn"), not to group size. The stated consequence is not on the page.

Third mistake "Chỉ cho ăn toàn đồ thực vật hoặc đồ nổi ... nên cho thêm thức ăn thịt cỡ nhỏ chìm xuống đáy": the page only describes the wild diet (small bottom invertebrates, biofilm). It gives no captive feeding advice about plant food, floating food or sinking meaty food, so this mistake and its fix are invented.

Summary "Điểm khó nhất là chuẩn bị chỗ có đá và bề mặt cứng ... cùng thức ăn đáy hợp khẩu vị": the page never says these are hard to provide or that cá need such tank setup. It extrapolates from the wild diet.

"hợp với người đã nuôi vài loại cá và muốn thử cá sọc vằn bản địa": the page and card never say who the fish suits or that it needs prior experience. Difficulty 4/8 alone doesn't support this. "bản địa" is also the summary's own framing.

"cần tìm hiểu thêm trước khi mua" and "kiểm tra vây lưng ... trước khi mua": buying advice the page does not give. The page only lists traits that tell A. iridescens from A. longipinnis. It gives no advice on buying.

"hợp với người đã nuôi cá vài năm": the page gives no keeper-experience requirement, and "vài vài năm" is an invented figure and unsupported suitability claim. The page only says the fish needs a large tank and a group.
"nên bố trí đá trong bể cho cá gặm": the page gives no tank-setup advice. It only says that in the wild the fish grazes biofilm on rocks, so this fix goes beyond the page.

"nên thông tin về cách nuôi còn ít": the page never says care information is scarce. It only says the species was described in 2007 and that the fish on sale come from Peru. The summary invents this conclusion and presents it as following from those two facts.

"hợp với người muốn nuôi cá dao mà không cần con quá lớn": the page says only that the fish is small for a knifefish (about 20 cm). It doesn't say who the species suits, so this suitability claim is a weak inference.

"Loài này hợp với người đã quen cichlid nhỏ": the page never says the species suits keepers with prior small-cichlid experience. The card rates it 4/8 (medium), and the page gives no experience requirement, so this suitability claim is unsupported.

"Chỉ cho ăn thức ăn không liên quan đến tảo ... nên bổ sung thức ăn thực vật hoặc tảo": the page only describes the wild diet ("Ngoài tự nhiên, cá ăn tảo bám..."). It gives no aquarium feeding advice. The mistake and its fix are advice the page doesn't give.
"10–15 cm" is neither the card's adult size (20 cm) nor its minimum tank (100 cm)
"chưa ai cho sinh sản được trong bể" states as certain what the page hedges: "Đến nay có lẽ chưa ai cho loài này sinh sản được trong bể" ("có lẽ" = probably). The hedge was dropped.

"cá hay bị bán trong tình trạng gầy và rất khó phục hồi": the page says this about fish of the family Gastromyzontidae in general, not about Annamia normani. It never says Annamia belongs to that family. The page also says only "khó phục hồi", so "rất" strengthens it. The summary turns a general remark into a certainty about this species and uses it as the hardest part of keeping it.
"nhất là khi nhiệt độ phòng thường cao hơn mức này" – the page says nothing about room temperature being higher than the range. This is an invented claim.
"Nuôi ở nhiệt độ phòng nóng thì cá khó chịu" – the page gives no information about room temperature or fish discomfort. It only gives the 18–22 °C range.
"hợp với người đã nuôi cá nhỏ" – the page gives no experience requirement. The card only says difficulty 4/8 (medium), so this suitability claim is unsupported.

"hợp với người đã nuôi cá nhỏ": the page never says the species suits people with prior experience of small fish. The card rates it easy (2/8) and the page only says it suits someone committed to a long-term project. The experience requirement is invented.
"10 cm" is not the card's adult size (50 cm)
"15 cm" is not the card's minimum tank (180 cm)

Third mistake: "Cho ăn ... dùng lâu dài cá bảy màu, cá vàng nhỏ làm mồi; nên cho dải thịt cá trắng, tôm nguyên con, giun đất". The page also says "Cá mồi là thức ăn bắt buộc phải có", so the fix to swap feeder fish for strips, shrimp and worms contradicts it. The page only calls long-term feeder fish of little benefit, and the summary turns that hedge into a firm mistake.

"1–2 bữa mỗi tuần" is given without saying it applies only to adult fish. The page says adults don't need daily feeding, and the other section says newly imported fish are hard to feed at first, so the schedule is stated too broadly.

"hợp với người đã có kinh nghiệm": the page never says the species suits experienced keepers. The card difficulty is 4/8 (medium), and the page says breeding is usually not too hard. The suitability claim is invented.
"hợp với người nuôi có kinh nghiệm, có bể lớn": the page and card give no difficulty rating, experience requirement or tank size/advice, so this suitability claim is not supported by the page.
"30 cm" is neither the card's adult size (none) nor its minimum tank (none)

Third mistake: "Để cá bố mẹ trong bể đẻ sau khi đẻ thì trứng bị ăn" states as certain that the eggs get eaten. The page hedges: parents "nhiều khả năng sẽ ăn trứng nếu có dịp" (likely to eat eggs if given the chance).

Mistake 2, "Đừng chỉ cho ăn thức ăn chìm đáy như nhiều loài trê khác ... nên cho ăn cả thức ăn nhỏ lơ lửng": the page describes only the wild diet (plankton filtering, small fish, insect larvae). It gives no captive feeding advice. Sinking food, suspended food and the comparison with other catfish are invented.

Summary, "nên khó đáp ứng nhu cầu ăn và không gian khi nuôi" and "chỉ hợp với người có hồ rất lớn, không hợp bể gia đình thông thường": the page says nothing about how hard the species is to keep, or about its feeding or space needs in captivity. The page does not say who it suits either. These claims go beyond the page.

"hợp với người đã nuôi betta hoang dã": the page never says this fish suits keepers who already have wild bettas or experience with them. The card's difficulty is only medium (4/8), so this audience claim is unsupported.

"hợp với người đã nuôi được vài loài cá mê cung": the page never says the species suits keepers who already have labyrinth-fish experience. This is an invented claim about who it suits. The page only says it is unsuited to a standard community tank and is shy.
"hợp với người đã nuôi betta hoang dã": the page never says the species needs an experienced or wild-betta keeper. The card rates it 4/8, which is medium, so this suitability claim is invented.

"hợp với người đã quen nuôi cá nhỏ": the page never says the species suits experienced small-fish keepers. It only says to keep it in a species-only tank and gives difficulty 4/8. The experience requirement is invented.

"thì cá khó sống tốt": the page only says the species is "không phải là cá lý tưởng cho bể cộng đồng" (not ideal). It says nothing about the fish doing poorly or struggling to survive, so the hedge became a stronger claim.

"Độ khó 6/8 (khó), vì cá quá lớn và chưa có ghi nhận sinh sản trong nuôi nhốt": the page gives the reason for the difficulty as needing a tank at least 2 m long. It never says the lack of recorded captive breeding makes the fish hard to keep, so this reason is invented.
"15 cm" is not the card's adult size (22,5 cm)
"5 cm" is neither the card's adult size (15 cm) nor its minimum tank (60 cm)
Summary says "Cần ... nền cát" as a requirement, but the page only hedges: gravel is usable and sand is "có lẽ là lựa chọn tốt hơn" (probably better). The hedge became a certainty.
"trùn chỉ muỗi lắc": the page lists "ấu trùng muỗi lắc (chironomid)". "Trùn chỉ" (tubifex worms) is a different food the page never mentions, so this is a garbled or invented food item.
"thì ảnh hưởng tuổi thọ và sức khỏe": the page says long-term freshwater or full seawater "có thể ảnh hưởng" (may affect) lifespan and health. The summary turns that hedge into a certainty.
"thì cá tích mỡ": the page says the fat "có thể gây tích mỡ thừa" (may cause excess fat build-up). The summary states it as certain.

"thì cá sẽ đánh nhau": the page says only that the fish "có thể hung hăng" (may be aggressive) toward relatives or similar-looking fish and is not sociable with its own kind. The summary states fighting as certain.
"5–8 cm" is neither the card's adult size (13,5 cm) nor its minimum tank (120 cm)

"5–8 cm" is neither the card's adult size (13,5 cm) nor its minimum tank (120 cm)
"5–8 cm" is neither the card's adult size (13,5 cm) nor its minimum tank (120 cm)

Mistake 1: "cá dễ bị sốc" when a lot of water is changed at once. The page doesn't say this. It only says to change a little but regularly because the species is sensitive when water quality declines. The shock claim is invented.
"rất khó cứu": the page says the emaciated state is "khá khó cứu" (fairly hard to save). The summary strengthens this to "very hard", which overstates the page's hedge.
"Cá mới nhập về còn yếu" turns the page's hedge ("có thể khá yếu", "đôi khi hơi yếu") into a certainty. The page also says fish are usually quite hardy once settled.

"hợp người đã quen cá ăn mồi động vật": the page never says the species suits keepers with experience of carnivorous fish. It calls the fish "dễ nuôi trong bể nhà", and the card difficulty is 2/8 (easy). The suitability claim is unsupported and leans against the easy rating.
"khó nhất là giữ nước mát": the page never says keeping water cool is hard. It only gives the 10–22 °C range, so this hardest point is the summary's own inference.
"hợp với người đã quen nuôi cá săn mồi": the page does not say the species suits experienced keepers of predatory fish. It only says the fish is an obligate predator and gives no audience advice.
"30 cm" is neither the card's adult size (20 cm) nor its minimum tank (120 cm)

"thì cá tích mỡ, có thể thoái hóa nội tạng": the page hedges both effects ("lâu dần có thể làm cá tích mỡ thừa, thậm chí gây thoái hóa nội tạng"). The summary states fat build-up as certain and drops "lâu dần".
"dễ mang ký sinh trùng, mầm bệnh": the page says feeder fish "có thể mang" parasites or pathogens. "Dễ" makes that hedge stronger.
"ưu tiên mồi tươi": the page doesn't say to prefer fresh or live prey. It says most fish take dead food easily.
"thức ăn khô làm món chính thì cá thiếu chất": the page only says dry food must never be the staple. It gives no reason, so the nutrient-deficiency consequence is invented.
"hợp với người đã quen nuôi cá săn mồi": the page and card give no experience level or difficulty, so this suitability claim isn't supported.

"Hợp với người đã quen cá săn mồi": the page never says the species suits keepers who already have experience with predatory fish. It only calls it an obligate predator, and the card rates difficulty as medium (4/8). This suitability claim is invented.
"30 cm" is neither the card's adult size (10 cm) nor its minimum tank (90 cm)

"hợp với người đã nuôi cá đẻ con vùng cao Mexico": the page never says this species suits keepers with prior experience of Mexican highland livebearers. The card rates difficulty as medium, and the page names no target keeper, so this suitability claim is invented.

"cá đực đánh nhau liên tục" and "trồng dày cây": the page only says cover makes males fight less ("bớt đánh nhau") and that males are territorial but can live together. It never says males fight constantly, and it never asks for dense planting. This turns a hedge into a certainty and adds advice the page doesn't give.

"cũng ít dinh dưỡng": the page says feeder fish are usually not nutritious only "nếu không nuôi vỗ kỹ từ trước" (if not conditioned beforehand). The summary drops that condition and states it as a certainty.
"dễ mang ký sinh trùng, mầm bệnh": the page says feeder fish "có nguy cơ" (carry a risk of) bringing in parasites or pathogens. "Dễ" (easily/likely) makes the hedge stronger.

"hợp với người đã nuôi quen cá nhỏ": the page never says who the species suits or that experience with small fish is needed. The card only gives difficulty 4/8 (medium), so this audience claim is invented.
Mistake 2: "cá ăn sạch cây và lao vỡ thiết bị" turns the page's hedge into a certainty. The page says a large fish "có thể dễ dàng làm vỡ" heaters and thermometers, not that it will break them.
Mistake 2: "nên làm lọc sump" drops the page's condition "Nếu được". The page gives sump as preferred if possible, and otherwise says to buy the biggest filter and change water often.
"5–8 cm" is neither the card's adult size (60 cm) nor its minimum tank (300 cm)
"5–8 cm" is not the card's adult size (60 cm)
"Thả chung các loài Copadichromis khác sẽ bị lai" turns the page's hedge ("có thể lai với nhau", they may hybridise) into a certainty.
"dễ lai với Copadichromis khác" in the summary overstates the page's "có thể lai" (may hybridise). The page doesn't say they hybridise easily.
"hợp với người đã nuôi cichlid Malawi": the page never says the species suits only experienced Malawi keepers. The card gives medium difficulty (4/8), so this suitability claim is invented.
"cần nền cát": the page says sand is only "hợp nhất" (the best fit), not required. The hedge became a certainty.

Mistake 3 "Bật đèn quá sáng và bể trống trải; nên để ánh sáng yếu, thêm rễ, cành lũa và cây nổi" turns hedged advice into a firm rule. The page says the fish "có vẻ sống tốt nhất dưới ánh sáng khá yếu", that decor "không quá quan trọng", and that floating plants "cũng có thể" help.
Summary "ánh sáng khá yếu và có nhiều chỗ râm" is stated as a requirement. The page only says "có vẻ" (seemingly) for weak light, and shade is offered as a way to make the tank look natural.

"cá bán ngoài thị trường nhiều khi là B. ambiacus": the page only says fish that look like B. ambiacus seem (có vẻ) more common and that identification is uncertain. The summary turns this into a certain identification.
"gai vây ngực cứng đâm thủng da và rất đau": the page says being stung "có thể rất đau" (can be very painful). The hedge became a certainty.

"hợp với người đã nuôi cá chuột vài lần": the page never says who the species suits or that prior Corydoras experience is needed. The card only gives medium difficulty 4/8, so this requirement is invented.
"chích rất đau": the page says being stung "có thể rất đau" (can be very painful), so the hedge became a certainty.
"Cầm cá trần tay": the page only says to be careful when handling the fish. It never mentions bare hands or any handling method, so this mistake is invented.
"Nuôi lẻ vài con thì cá thiếu yên tâm": the page does not say that a small group makes the fish insecure. It only says to keep at least 4–6. Hiding places are what make the fish feel secure.
"hợp với người mới đến trung bình" puts the species at beginner-to-medium level. The card's difficulty is 2/8, which is easy (dễ), so "trung bình" does not fit that band.

Third mistake: "chọn bạn cùng bể hợp với mức 21–24 °C, như tetra nhỏ hay cá mê cung" says tetras and labyrinth fish suit 21–24 °C. The page lists them as gentle tank mates but never says they tolerate that temperature. It only says to consider the species' lower temperature preference when choosing tank mates.
Mistake 1: "chỉ 2–3 con" uses a group size that the page doesn't write. The page only says to keep at least 4–6.

Mistake 1: "thì cá mất yên tâm" gives an unsupported result of keeping too few. The page links feeling secure to hiding places, not to group size. It only says the fish are peaceful and like living in a group.

"dùng lọc dưới nền có thể làm cá rụng râu": the page only says not to use an undergravel filter, with no reason given. It links barbel loss to dirty substrate or poor conditions, not to the filter. The summary invents this cause.

"Dùng lọc đáy ... thì cá dễ rụng râu": the page only says not to use an undergravel filter and, separately, that poor conditions may cause barbel loss. It never links the undergravel filter to barbel loss.
"hợp người đã nuôi vài bể": the page says nothing about keeper experience. This only loosely follows from the card's medium difficulty and is an unsupported suitability claim.
"cá khá hung dữ, nhất là với đồng loại": the page hedges ("Cá có thể khá hung dữ"), but the summary states it as a certainty.
"ăn bất cứ con cá nào nhỏ vừa miệng": the page says only "nhiều khả năng sẽ bị nó ăn" (likely), so this is stronger than the page.
"con nào đủ nhỏ để vừa miệng sẽ bị ăn": the page's "nhiều khả năng" (likely) is dropped, so a likelihood becomes a certainty.
"vì cá hay đào bới": the page says "nhiều khả năng sẽ đào bới" (likely to dig), not that it habitually does.

"thì cá nhút nhát, con yếu bị bắt nạt liên tục": the page hedges this. It says that with one or a few fish they "có thể trở nên nhút nhát", and that weaker fish "có thể bị bắt nạt liên tục". The summary states both as certain.
"Cho ăn nhiều đạm dễ làm cá tích mỡ, thoái hóa nội tạng": the page says this only "có thể" happens, and only with frequent, long-term feeding. The summary turns that hedge into a likely outcome.

"hợp người đã nuôi cá một thời gian" is not on the page. The page calls Ctenopoma a good choice for "người mới tập chơi cá 'lạ'" (newcomers to exotic fish). It says nothing about needing prior fishkeeping experience, so this changes who the species suits.
"chưa từng được cho sinh sản trong bể": the page hedges this with "người ta cho rằng loài này chưa từng được cho sinh sản trong bể" (it is only believed so). The summary states it as a certainty.

Mistake 2 fix: "Nên chọn bạn bể khỏe hơn" is advice the page doesn't give. The page only warns that big adults may bully slow or shy tank mates. It also says many fish suit as tank mates (cyprinids, loaches, cichlids, catfish, characins). It never says to pick tank mates that are stronger.
"cá hoang dã nhập về khá hiếm": the page never says the wild-caught fish are rare. It only says the best way to get the fish is probably to watch for wild lots imported from Indochina.
"nên phải theo dõi sát": the page gives no advice to monitor the fish closely. This is invented advice.
"Để bể trống trơn thì cá dễ nhát": the page only says it is best not to leave the tank completely bare. It gives no reason, and nothing links a bare tank to shyness.

"lọc mạnh nhưng dòng chảy yếu": the page recommends an external canister filter, a sump, or both, to keep the water stable. It never calls for strong filtration, and it says the tank should not have strong flow. "lọc mạnh" is an unsupported embellishment.

"người đã có kinh nghiệm cichlid Tanganyika": the page does not say the species suits keepers with Tanganyika cichlid experience. It only says not to add the fish to an unstable tank and that beginners should not strip eggs. This specific suitability claim is invented.

"chỉ hợp bạn cùng bể hiền của Tanganyika": the page only says these tank mates are "hợp hơn" (better suited) and rules out Mbuna. It does not say that only gentle Tanganyika fish suit. The summary turns a comparison into an exclusive rule.

Mistake 2: "hoặc kiểu đuôi vàng, đuôi xanh khác nhau" is not supported. The page says every geographic form comes in both yellow-tail and blue-tail types, and it forbids mixing the geographic forms ("các dạng"), not the tail types. The summary turns a ban on mixing geographic forms into a ban on mixing tail colours.
"43,8 °C": the card gives no temperature

"hợp với người đã nuôi cá vài năm": the page gives no advice about how many years of experience a keeper needs. "vài năm" is an invented figure and an invented suitability claim. The page only gives difficulty 4/8 (medium).

Mistake 3: "Chỉ cho ăn thức ăn nổi hoặc thức ăn khô thì gần như vô ích vì cá hiếm lên mặt nước" is wrong about dry food. The page says only floating food is "gần như vô ích". It says the fish accept medium-sized dry food but shouldn't be fed only that. The summary extends "vô ích" to all dry food, which the page doesn't say.

"Hợp với người đã nuôi vài loài": the page never says the species suits keepers with prior experience. This audience claim is invented. The page only gives difficulty 4/8 (medium) and says it is rare and best kept as a single species.
"Nuôi 2–4 con chung": the page doesn't give the range 2–4. It says to keep one fish or a group of 5 or more. The number is worked out from the text, so it counts as not written.

"hợp với người đã có tay nghề": the page never says the species suits experienced keepers. It says only that it suits public display tanks or extra-large home tanks. The card rates difficulty 4/8, which is medium.

"Nuôi lẻ vài con thì cá nhát và hay gây hấn": the page says only that a full group makes the fish less shy, and that aggression in a group stays mild because males sort out rank. It never says that keeping a few fish makes them aggressive.

Mistake 2 "Cho ăn nhiều đồ mặn, đồ sống" contradicts the page: the page says the fish also eats small live and frozen food (bloodworms, brine shrimp) and "Bạn có thể cho ăn các món này thường xuyên", so frequent live food is not a mistake.
"đồ mặn" (salty/meaty food) is not on the page. The page never gives it as a feeding error.

Mistake 2: "Đưa cá vào bể có loài hung dữ hoặc khác hẳn tính cách thì cá khó yên ổn" – the page never says the fish is harmed by aggressive tank mates. It only recommends a gentle community and gives suitable tank mates.

Summary: "dựng bể giống suối nước đen" is called a hard point, and the fish is called unsuitable for "người chỉ muốn thả cá vào bể trống". The page offers a densely planted tank as an equal option to the biotope. It says nothing about who it is unsuitable for.

Mistake 3: "Để bể trống, sáng gắt thì không đúng môi trường của cá" – the page does not warn about bare tanks or bright light. It only describes weak light as part of the biotope setup, and it also accepts a densely planted tank.

"Khó nhất là dựng bể kiểu suối nước đen": the page never says a blackwater or forest-stream tank is hard to set up. It only says the fish do well in a densely planted tank or a biotope tank, so this difficulty claim is unsupported.

"nước gần như sạch tinh và giàu oxy": the page only hedges that the fish "nhiều khả năng ưa nước giàu oxy hòa tan và dòng chảy vừa phải". The summary states high oxygen as a firm requirement, so a hedge became a certainty.

Mistake 3: "Bể thiếu hang hốc ... sẽ gây tranh lãnh thổ" – the page says caves are for hiding and holding territory. It never says a lack of caves causes territorial fights, and it never says that adding caves fixes them. The page gives only the tank-size reason for keeping a group.
"Hợp với người đã quen bể nước lợ hoặc nước cứng" – the page doesn't say the fish suits only keepers with that experience. It says only that the fish suits brackish or hard-water community tanks.

"hợp với người đã quen cichlid Tanganyika": the page never says the species suits people experienced with Tanganyika cichlids. This is an invented suitability claim, and the card rates difficulty as medium (4/8).
"180 x 90 x 120 cm": the card gives no minimum tank
